{{Quote|I was working in the consular gardens and I found a datacard hidden in the main planter. Well, I knew it shouldn't be there, and I tried to return it to the chief of the household staff.|Spero|<ref name="Spero's Flight">{{WEGCite|story=Spero's Flight|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
An individual worked as the '''chief''' of the [[Alderaanian Embassy|Alderaan consulate's]] household staff on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] consulate during this [[Time/Legends|time]] served as private go-between for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents.

Although [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] did not approve Rebel operatives to use the main planter as a drop point the chief hid a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] there, which put [[Master Gardener]] [[Spero]] in trouble.
